parameter_semantics: object_pose_field selects the observed block world pose used in causal relations; destination_pose_field selects the observed destination world pose; tunnel_clearance_m is the 0.16 m world-z clearance used as a phase feature. The learned Cartesian displacement is always referenced to the freshly measured TCP and is not an HL actuator argument.
output_semantics: Each slot is [translation x,y,z metres in the fresh measured TCP body frame, relative TCP rotation vector x,y,z radians, gripper scalar]. decode composes measured_world_TCP @ represented_delta at that execution slot and calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh measured joints. Gripper >=0 opens and <0 closes. The sequence is feedback-style rather than accumulated: each slot is resolved from that slot's fresh TCP. Slots represent t-1..t+14 and execution uses 1..8.

conversion_check.description: Encoding relative to each pre-action measured TCP and decoding from the same observation must recover demonstrated command FK TCP and gripper within 0.01 maximum metres/radians/scalar; IK diagnostics remain explicit.

cut_relation: Supervises every assigned action [300,840) for all demonstrations, including [300,440) predecessor and [680,840) successor overlap; no action is trimmed for the local-delta representation.
